config.label: Private key of the paying wallet, hex with or without 0x
config.description: Private key of the paying wallet, hex with or without 0x. Use a throwaway wallet holding only a few dollars of USDC on Base. Without it, only the free catalogue and price tools work.

config.label: Ceiling per call in USDC
config.description: Ceiling per call in USDC. A more expensive service is refused, not bought. Default 0.05.

config.label: Ceiling per session in USDC
config.description: Ceiling per session in USDC. Once reached the server refuses further paid calls. Default 1.00.

config.label: hero (12 curated services, default), gateway (3 meta-tools, smallest context) or all (70 services)
config.description: hero (12 curated services, default), gateway (3 meta-tools, smallest context) or all (70 services).

config.label: Set to 1 for a dry run: returns price and call plan, pays nothing
config.description: Set to 1 for a dry run: returns price and call plan, pays nothing.
